title: Design exercise: SAA-4.1-S04
scenario: Tallowmere Podcasts keeps 9 TB of finished episode audio in object storage, growing by 1 TB a month. Its 12 editing servers share a file system that grew from 2 TB to 5 TB with no administrator action. Its publishing database sits on one 1 TB block volume holding 800 GB today; a bulk catalogue import of up to 150 GB, arriving about weekly, has twice filled that volume at 3 a.m. and stopped publishing until staff enlarged it by hand. Nobody is on call overnight.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
Nothing may depend on a person waking up to add storage
The platform team will not build automation for a store that already grows on its own
Capacity must not be bought ahead of need for any of the three stores

rubric.label: For each of the three stores the record states whether growth needs any design work and gives the reason from the scenario
A 150 GB import at 3 a.m. completes without publishing stopping and without a person acting

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
